title: AdvanceDrop
description: Complete advancements, earn chests, unbox your loot. Nine tiers from dirt to netherite — the harder the grind, the better the drop.
body:
# AdvanceDrop

Finish the advancement. Roll the drop. Open the case.

Nine chest tiers. Hundreds of possible drops. One secret chest nobody sees coming. AdvanceDrop turns every Minecraft advancement into a case opening — and the grind never felt this good.

---

## How It Works

Complete any vanilla advancement, receive a chest item, right-click to open and collect your loot.

---

## Chest Tiers

| Tier | Loot |
|------|------|
| Dirt | Basic blocks, starter food, simple resources |
| Copper | Starter ores, coal, utility items |
| Iron | Iron tools, weapons, survival gear |
| Gold | Golden apples, gold ingots, intermediate gear |
| Emerald | Emeralds, enchanted books, villager loot |
| Diamond | Diamonds, diamond gear, obsidian |
| Netherite | Netherite ingots, ancient debris, top tier gear |
| Secret | 3% chance on ANY advancement, rare easter eggs and OP gear |
| Troll | Configurable chance for a trick chest filled with dummy drops |

---

## Difficulty System

- **Easy** - Story and basic crafting advancements
- **Medium** - Nether and exploration advancements
- **Hard** - End dimension, hidden, and Challenge advancements

Recipe unlocks are automatically filtered out so you never get spammed with chests.

---

## Crafting

Most chest tier can also be crafted directly in game.

| Tier | Recipe |
|------|--------|
| Dirt | Chest surrounded by Dirt |
| Copper | Chest surrounded by Copper Ingots |
| Iron | Chest surrounded by Iron Ingots |
| Gold | Chest surrounded by Gold Ingots |
| Emerald | Chest surrounded by Emeralds |
| Diamond | Chest surrounded by Diamonds |
| Netherite | Chest surrounded by Diamond Blocks |
| Secret | Secret recipe — figure it out yourself |
| Troll | Troll recipe — good luck |

---

## Effects and Animations

- Animated HUD popup with tier color on screen
- Screen shake on Netherite and Secret drops
- Particle explosions scaling with tier rarity
- Custom sounds on chest unlock

---

## Config and Commands

JSON config file auto-generated at `config/advancedrop.json`

Configurable options:
- `modEnabled` - Toggle the mod on or off
- `minChestsPerAdvancement` / `maxChestsPerAdvancement` - Set chest count range
- `trollChestChance` - Control troll chest probability (default 5%)
- `playLevelUpSound` - Toggle reward sounds

Admin command (permission level 2+):
- `/advancedrop chest <tier> [count]` - Spawn a specific chest tier for testing

---

## Compatibility

- Loader: Fabric
- Minecraft: 1.21 to 26.1.2
- Java: 21 or later
- Required: Fabric API, Cloth Config, ModMenu
